title: Moving Truck (Rule of Five)

links.title: C++ Core Guidelines C.21: define or delete all five

hints: Constructor: data_ = new int[size]() - the () zero-initialises. Destructor: delete[] data_ (delete[] nullptr is fine).
Copy constructor: allocate a NEW array and std::copy the elements (deep copy). Copying only the pointer makes two objects delete the same memory.
Move constructor: steal the pointer and leave the source empty: size_(std::exchange(other.size_, 0)), data_(std::exchange(other.data_, nullptr)).
Assignments: guard against self-assignment (if (this != &other)), release what you currently own, then copy or steal. Mark both move operations noexcept.
